reviews.outcome: The hyperimmune-free basis proof is used only for nonempty computable binary trees, with explicit finite-level compactness and uniform output-bound search supplied in the corpus. Its shorthand intersection of trees must mean intersection of path classes. CENZER-CT-01 repairs the bound variable in the truth-table consequence, and the source finite-prefix convention includes a time bound, so the divergence test there is decidable. Findings02–06 concern excluded adjacent statements/proofs and are not carried into the new entries. No whole-book audit is claimed.

reviews.outcome: Exact same-input freezing and prefix certificates retain the original tree/path/program model. A joint ordinary least-level/output-maximum procedure and primitive-recursive actual compiler supply the uniform bound. Finite restriction histories and nested-level compactness establish the basis theorem without an effective sequence of choices. The same Kleene/DNC member yields a noncomputable hyperimmune-free actual PA oracle, outside the sets computable from K and not low. All previously recorded excluded universal-low-basis, Scott-pruning and randomness claims remain excluded.
